newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-INJURED SKIPPER LAUDRUP TO MISS SLOVENIA MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED SKIPPER LAUDRUP TO MISS SLOVENIA MATCH.

text.p: Danish national team captain Michael Laudrup will miss the World Cup European Group One qualifier against Slovenia in Copenhagen on April 30 after suffering a knee injury in Japan.
"Fortunately it is not a serious injury. It should heal by itself, so I will just have to be patient and wait and see what happens," Laudrup told Denmark's Ritzau news agency on Thursday.

Laudrup tore a knee ligament while playing for his Japanese team Vissel Kobe last week and he is expected to be out of action for 10 weeks which means he will also miss Denmark's World Cup qualifier with Bosnia on June 8.
The midfielder pulled out of Denmark's last qualifier against Croatia in Split in March citing lack of training. He was named in Denmark's 18-man squad for Slovenia earlier this week.
